# City Icons Collection

> Minimalist SVG line-art icons of 295 cities worldwide, each depicting the city's
> most recognizable landmark. By Studio Partdirector (https://partdirector.ch).

## Structure

- Homepage with the full searchable collection: https://svgcities.com
- Country pages: https://svgcities.com/{country-slug} (e.g. /spain)
- City pages: https://svgcities.com/{country-slug}/{city-slug} (e.g. /spain/barcelona)
- SVG files: https://svgcities.com/icons/{country-code}-{city}.svg (e.g. /icons/es-barcelona.svg)

## Machine-readable index

- https://svgcities.com/icons.json — the full collection as static JSON. Each entry
  has id, name (landmark), city, country, region, category, tags, svgFilename, and
  absolute svgUrl and pageUrl.
- https://svgcities.com/city-icons.zip — all SVG icons in one archive.
